scripts.dev: pnpm run ensure-tmp && cross-env TMPDIR=./tmp NODE_ENV=development tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.start:prod: pnpm run ensure-tmp && cross-env TMPDIR=./tmp NODE_ENV=production tsx src/server.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run ensure-tmp && cross-env TMPDIR=./tmp vitest run src/routes/*.test.ts
scripts.prisma: pnpm run ensure-tmp && cross-env TMPDIR=./tmp prisma
scripts.db:bootstrap: pnpm run ensure-tmp && cross-env TMPDIR=./tmp tsx src/db/bootstrap.ts --seed-mode=dev
scripts.db:bootstrap:prod: pnpm run ensure-tmp && cross-env TMPDIR=./tmp tsx src/db/bootstrap.ts --seed-mode=prod
scripts.db:bootstrap:no-seed: pnpm run ensure-tmp && cross-env TMPDIR=./tmp tsx src/db/bootstrap.ts --no-seed
scripts.db:reset: pnpm run ensure-tmp && cross-env TMPDIR=./tmp tsx src/db/bootstrap.ts --reset --seed-mode=dev
scripts.seed:dev: pnpm run ensure-tmp && cross-env TMPDIR=./tmp tsx src/db/bootstrap.ts --seed-only --seed-mode=dev
scripts.seed:prod: pnpm run ensure-tmp && cross-env TMPDIR=./tmp tsx src/db/bootstrap.ts --seed-only --seed-mode=prod
scripts.check:all: pnpm prisma validate && pnpm build && pnpm test
